open_issues.title: Numbers mismatch across sections for Leukemia and SRBCT
open_issues.details: Resolved via frozen single-source-of-truth macros in numbers.tex. Leukemia is 0.680, SRBCT is 0.538.

open_issues.title: Dataset and method counts mismatch in text vs figures
open_issues.details: Resolved. Text and Table 3 consistently state 13 multi-domain datasets x 11 candidate algorithms (1,430 fits). Figures 14 and 17 display 13 datasets.

open_issues.title: Nemenyi CD calculation mismatch and overall ranking fifth
open_issues.details: Resolved. Nemenyi CD is corrected to 4.21 (k=11, N=13). DEC is 1st (4.31), ICC-v2 is 5th (5.46) overall, and 1st (2.33) on exploratory D/N>20 subgroup with explicit post-hoc Holm adjustment caveats.

open_issues.title: VSSG alone hurts clustering on Leukemia
open_issues.details: Explicitly documented in Section 5.2. VSSG+KMeans achieves 0.019 vs 0.101 for raw KMeans. Gains require bipartite anchor consensus.

open_issues.title: Uncalibrated ASPP and Inductive Step never evaluated directly
open_issues.details: Documented in Table 1 taxonomy and Section 4.4. ASPP is framed strictly as an optional diagnostic tool with enable_aspp=False default.

open_issues.title: Inconsistent mathematical definitions in manuscript
open_issues.details: Harmonized Eq 2, Eq 9, Alg 1. Proposition 1 constant is proven as Delta/sigma > sqrt((3+sqrt(15))/2) = 1.854.

open_issues.title: H4 Confirmatory Decision Rule Failed on Tier-A
open_issues.details: NCG-BC failed downstream clustering gain vs G2 (mean diff -0.0035) and G4 (mean diff -0.0319). Downstream clustering claim withdrawn per Rule A7.

decisions.summary: Adopted Option (c) for Study 3': Restrict confirmatory claim to F1, F2, F5; report F3/F4 bounded support as boundary-bias scope limit.
Executed Kill Rule A7: Withdrew downstream clustering improvement claim for NCG after H4 failure across Tier-A.
Ported manuscript to Springer Nature sn-jnl template (sn-mathphys-num) in springer_manuscript/main.tex and successfully built main.pdf via Tectonic.
Recommended Pattern Analysis and Applications (PAAP) as primary target journal, with Data Mining and Knowledge Discovery (DAMI) as alternative.
